subject: organic
question: 有机化学·自由基极性：根据 Radical Learn 所采用的常见反应性分类，NHC–boryl radical 通常主要表现为亲核型还是亲电型自由基？（回答该教材中的主要倾向，具体反应条件可能影响表现。）
explanation_en: Boron is less electronegative than carbon (2.04): ligated boryl radicals are nucleophilic. An NHC–BH₂• radical added to methyl acrylate at least 380 times faster than to ethyl vinyl ether.
